text:
maya: Quick heads-up — nightly smoke failed on hosted-integ shard=19. auth handshake + toolcall 502s showing up intermittently. Not seen locally.

simon: Can you paste the failing test name and the tail of the server response?

maya: test name: `test_stream_toolcall_auth_flow::test_basic_roundtrip`
Logs snippet:```
INFO  auth: handshake start user=svc-ci
WARN  auth: kid lookup returned null
ERR   toolcall: upstream returned 502 for /invoke (body: \"Bad Gateway\")
ERR   client: got 401 from auth when retrying kv fetch
```

raj: I can kick a rerun on shard=19, want me to do that?

maya: please, thanks. ping here when started.

ci-bot: @raj started rerun of smoke-suite on shard=19 (attempt 1) — https://ci.internal/runs/71234 :running: 

ci-bot: rerun logs streaming: https://ci.internal/runs/71234/logs

simon: quick Q — any auth-related merges in last 24h? I remember a kid rotation change landed yesterday (#3421).

olivia: yes, token-service job rotated keys 08:05 UTC today per ops-runbook. Might overlap with CI run.

maya: adding the curl response we see in CI:```
> POST /invoke HTTP/1.1
> Host: toolsvc.internal
> Authorization: Bearer ey...
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< content-type: application/json
< {
<   \"error\": \"upstream_error\",
<   \"detail\": \"couldn't verify kid\"
< }
```

simon: ok that matches theory: if token verifier can't find kid during rotation, some requests fail. Will try local repro with KID_ROTATION=1 env.

raj: bisect request: can we bisect between last-green=1717602000 and first-red=1717768000? I have compute to run parallel shards.

ci-bot: bisect job queued by @raj (range 1717602000..1717768000). Starting parallel job 6 workers.

ci-bot: bisect progress: suspect commit `abc1234` — auth middleware change that deferred kid cache update. Full log: https://ci.internal/bisect/8932

simon: reproduced locally with `KID_ROTATION=1` plus race on kid cache. Flaky repro rate ~30%.

maya: captured header where kid is missing:```
Authorization: Bearer ey...
Header.kid: null
```

olivia: ops confirms rotation job wrote new keys at 08:04:52 but cache TTL is long, so some verifiers see stale state while others see new.

simon: short-term mitigation options:
- add a retry with small exponential backoff on 502/401 from toolcall
- pin the kid in CI env to previous key until we fix cache logic
- revert the cache change in abc1234 for CI runs only

raj: I'll try the pin-in-CI approach first; cheaper and fast. Kicking that patch to the smoke-runner.

maya: if you push the pin, can you also trigger a rerun of the failing shard afterwards?

raj: done — pushed `ci-pin-kid` to smoke-runner and triggered rerun (attempt 2).

ci-bot: rerun started by @raj — run 71256.

ci-bot: run 71256 status: still flaky — some tests passed, shard 19 still had 1 failing case.

simon: pushed quick patch to toolcall client to add 3 retries with jitter for auth failures, and added a targeted test for the rotation window. PR: https://git.internal/pulls/4567

ci-bot: PR #4567 opened by @simon — preview build queued.

maya: will monitor. thanks for the quick turnaround. please add notes in PR about the bisect and ops rotation.

olivia: ops will coordinate to avoid key rotations during the next CI window; will also add step to warm caches right after rotation.

ci-bot: preview build for PR #4567 passed unit tests, integration preview queued.

simon: merged #4567 (small retry + test). Also added a follow-up ticket to improve kid cache update ordering (ENG-2139).

ci-bot: triggered nightly smoke reruns across affected shards.

ci-bot: rerun results: shard=19 all green in run 71302. All smoke shards green.

maya: great, thanks everyone. I will close the oncall TODO once I see prod smoke ok.

olivia: ops note: scheduled rotation window adjusted to avoid CI for next 48h.

simon: put a short blurb in the release notes about the transient rotation race and the retry mitigation.

maya: ack, closing thread after one more green. cc @raj :thumbsup:

ci-bot: final check run 71345 completed — all smoke green. Closing thread.
